marketplace.name: egoist-engineering-foundation
marketplace.description: Evidence-driven, token-conscious engineering workflows for coding agents.

plugins.name: engineering-foundation-core
plugins.description: Task contracts, bounded planning and orchestration, surgical implementation, debugging, research, review, verification, and handoff.
plugins.short_description: Lean planning, implementation, review, verification, and handoff.
default_prompts: Complete this task with the smallest defensible change and fresh evidence.
Review this diff against its task contract and report only material findings.

plugins.name: engineering-foundation-laravel
plugins.description: Repository-aware Laravel and PHP engineering using installed versions, local conventions, database evidence, tests, and Laravel Boost when present.
plugins.short_description: Project-aware Laravel and PHP engineering with evidence.
default_prompts: Inspect this Laravel project and make the smallest version-compatible change.

plugins.name: engineering-foundation-design
plugins.description: Single-direction interface design, design-contract authoring, implementation states, accessibility, and rendered visual verification.
plugins.short_description: One coherent UI direction with rendered visual verification.
default_prompts: Choose one coherent interface direction, implement it, and verify the rendered states.

plugins.name: engineering-foundation-cloud
plugins.description: Codex Cloud and remote-agent environment readiness with idempotent setup, bounded network access, secret safety, caching, and reproducible checks.
plugins.short_description: Safe, reproducible setup for Codex Cloud and remote agents.
default_prompts: Audit this repository for a safe and reproducible Codex Cloud environment.

plugins.name: engineering-foundation-authoring
plugins.description: Author and maintain compact Agent Skills and plugin packages with precise triggers, progressive disclosure, provenance, validation, and eval coverage.
plugins.short_description: Build compact, testable Agent Skills and plugin packages.
default_prompts: Create or revise this Agent Skill with precise triggers and eval coverage.
